utility.name: PHP 7.4 (sury, Debian 12 Bookworm)
utility.author: Thomas Shaw
utility.description: Installs PHP 7.4 from the deb.sury.org third-party apt repository alongside Debian 12's own PHP 8.2, then makes 7.4 the default PHP for both the CLI (`update-alternatives --set php`) and, once Apache is present, the apache2 PHP handler module. This is additional software, not a downgrade of any system package: php8.2 is left installed.
